[!race] skip 'race detector not supported'

# Inspect the generic SSA immediately after instrumentation. This avoids
# depending on architecture-specific register allocation or assembly syntax.
go tool compile -race -p=p -o scalar.o '-d=ssa/build/dump=Read1,ssa/build/dump=Write1,ssa/build/dump=Read2,ssa/build/dump=Write2,ssa/build/dump=Read4,ssa/build/dump=Write4,ssa/build/dump=Read8,ssa/build/dump=Write8,ssa/build/dump=ReadComposite,ssa/build/dump=WriteComposite,ssa/build/dump=DeleteScalarKey' scalar.go
! stdout .
! stderr .

# One-byte accesses retain the legacy single-address hooks.
grep -count=1 'runtime.raceread}}' Read1_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.racereadn' Read1_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racewrite}}' Write1_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.racewriten' Write1_01__build.dump

# Two-, four-, and eight-byte scalar accesses pass their exact width.
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[2\]' Read2_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racereadn}}' Read2_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.raceread}}' Read2_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[2\]' Write2_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racewriten}}' Write2_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.racewrite}}' Write2_01__build.dump

grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[4\]' Read4_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racereadn}}' Read4_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.raceread}}' Read4_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[4\]' Write4_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racewriten}}' Write4_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.racewrite}}' Write4_01__build.dump

grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[8\]' Read8_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racereadn}}' Read8_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.raceread}}' Read8_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[8\]' Write8_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racewriten}}' Write8_01__build.dump
! grep 'runtime.racewrite}}' Write8_01__build.dump

# Composite accesses continue to use range hooks with the full object size.
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[16\]' ReadComposite_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racereadrange}}' ReadComposite_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[16\]' WriteComposite_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.racewriterange}}' WriteComposite_01__build.dump

# Deletion reads both the global map header and scalar key at their exact width,
# then invokes a mapdelete helper, which reaches runtime.raceReadObjectPC.
grep -count=1 'Const(32|64) <uintptr> \[8\]' DeleteScalarKey_01__build.dump
grep -count=2 'runtime.racereadn}}' DeleteScalarKey_01__build.dump
grep -count=1 'runtime.mapdelete(_fast64)?}}' DeleteScalarKey_01__build.dump

# The instrumented corpus must compile unchanged for both backend selections.
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -race -buildmode=archive -o scalar_purego.a scalar.go

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] go build -race -buildmode=archive -o scalar_tsan.a scalar.go

-- scalar.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package p

var scalar1 byte
var scalar2 uint16
var scalar4 uint32
var scalar8 uint64
var composite [2]uint64
var scalarMap = make(map[uint64]int)

func Read1() byte              { return scalar1 }
func Write1(x byte)            { scalar1 = x }
func Read2() uint16            { return scalar2 }
func Write2(x uint16)          { scalar2 = x }
func Read4() uint32            { return scalar4 }
func Write4(x uint32)          { scalar4 = x }
func Read8() uint64            { return scalar8 }
func Write8(x uint64)          { scalar8 = x }
func DeleteScalarKey()         { delete(scalarMap, scalar8) }
func ReadComposite() [2]uint64 { return composite }
func WriteComposite(x [2]uint64) {
	composite = x
}
